name: Tilbeon for WooCommerce
author: vprodukter

sections.description:
Tilbeon is for shops that sell clothing, workwear, or merch in sizes, and that need a formal quote before the customer pays. Customers add products to a quote list, enter quantities, and send a request. The shop reviews the request in WooCommerce, sends back a quote, and the customer can accept it and pay or be invoiced.

It works on its own. When Embleon for WooCommerce is also active, logo positions, decoration methods, and artwork can be carried into the quote instead of being flattened to a bare product line.

Nothing is shown on the storefront until Enable is checked under WooCommerce → Tilbeon.

Features:

  • An “Add to quote” button on simple and variable products, and a quote list page with a request form.
  • Quote requests are stored in WooCommerce → Quotes, with WooCommerce emails to the shop and the customer.
  • The shop prices each line, adds shipping and a discount, and sends the quote. The customer opens a private link and accepts it (a payable WooCommerce order is created) or rejects it.
  • Optional switches to hide prices or the add-to-cart button while quote requests are enabled.
  • Works with Embleon for WooCommerce: logo positions, decoration lines, and logo files carry into the quote and the order.

Tilbeon Pro

A separate commercial plugin, Tilbeon Pro, is available from V Produkter for shops that want extras such as PDF quotes and a size grid. This plugin works fully on its own and does not need it.

Requirements

WordPress 6.2 or later, PHP 8.0 or later, and WooCommerce 8.2 or later. Compatible with high-performance order storage (HPOS) and with Cart and Checkout blocks.

Privacy

Quote requests store the details the customer enters (name, email, company, phone, VAT number, message, and an optional file) in your WordPress database, like a WooCommerce order. This plugin does not send data to any external service and does not track visitors. Customers open their quote through a private link with a random token.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the tilbeon-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the zip from Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin. Activation writes default settings. It does not change products or orders.
  3. Open WooCommerce → Quotes and WooCommerce → Tilbeon when you are ready to configure it. Tick Enable before anything appears on the storefront.

Requires WordPress 6.2+, PHP 8.0+, and WooCommerce 8.2+.
sections.faq:
Why is nothing visible on the product page?

Tick Enable under WooCommerce → Tilbeon. The add-to-quote button then appears on simple and variable products.

What is removed if I uninstall the plugin?

Only the plugin settings, unless you have chosen to keep data. Quote records and uploaded files are left in place.
sections.changelog:
1.0.2

  • Security hardening: nonce checks before reading form data, input sanitized as soon as it is read, and output escaped, including filtered button markup and email footers.
  • Admin styles are enqueued instead of printed inline.
  • The “WooCommerce is required” notice shows only on the Plugins screen.

1.0.1

  • Translations are delivered by WordPress.org.
  • All internal names use the tilbeon prefix. Quotes, settings, and order data saved by 1.0.0 are renamed once on update.
  • Compatible with Embleon 1.0.4.
  • Fixed a fatal error on product pages when Embleon was active.
  • Escaping and input sanitizing fixes.

1.0.0

  • First release: quote requests from simple and variable products, a quote list and request form, WooCommerce emails, priced quotes with shipping and discounts, accept-and-pay or reject from a private link, and the Embleon integration.

short_description: Quote requests and bulk size-run orders for merch and workwear shops. Works on its own, and is better with Embleon.
